summary: 1 listener(s) from the team rated 30 snippets blind, each against the same words in the speaker's clean take. Findings outside any scripted flaw were heard as worse delivery 12/16 times (75 %, 95 % CI 50-90 %); scripted flaws 6/7; random spans with no finding 0/7, so listeners were not simply calling everything worse. Counting those as real, precision on the team recordings rises from 22 % (scripted flaws only) to an estimated 80 % (95 % range 61-92 %). The listener named the same problem as the detector in 17 % of those cases: SpeechLens locates unscripted problems more reliably than it labels them. With a single listener who knows the project, treat this as an estimate, not a measurement.
